meta.rig_note: Marshall DSL201 removed 2026-09-14 (amp down, unknown how long/if it returns). Rig is Mesa Mark V:35 + Peavey Bandit 112 only. Prior 3-amp data (Marshall included) is recoverable from git history if Marshall comes back.
meta.mesa_control: Voodoo Lab Control Switcher, set to PC mode (not CC). Each mesa_preset name below must be manually programmed onto Control Switcher itself (hold button 1 + button 4 while the switches are in the target combination) under the PC number listed in mesa_presets_pc, before sending this bank plan does anything useful.

mesa_preset_definitions.clean_eq_off: Channel=Clean, Solo1=off, EQ=off (featured/solo clean tone) - still programmed on Control Switcher as PC2, not used by any patch in the current single-bank layout
mesa_preset_definitions.dirty_eq_off: Channel=Dirty, Solo1=off, EQ=off - still programmed on Control Switcher as PC4, not used by any patch in the current single-bank layout

switchtrack_pc_meanings_in_use.1: Peavey audible (Switch-Track OUTA - moved here 2026-09-14 from OUTB)

meta.switchtrack_note: Peavey's audio cable moved from Switch-Track OUTB to OUTA (Marshall's old, now-unused audio leg) 2026-09-14, consolidating alongside the earlier SWITCH1 relay move. Only PC1 and PC7 are meaningful now with a single remaining Switch-Track amp.
meta.peavey_switching: FCB1010 built-in relay SWITCH1 (fcb_switch1_relay: on=dirty, off=clean). Moved here from SWITCH2 on 2026-09-14, consolidating onto SWITCH1 since Marshall (SWITCH1's original amp) is out and not expected back. Polarity carried over from the SWITCH2 confirmation (2026-09-11) on the assumption that it's a property of Peavey's own footswitch jack, not of which FCB1010 relay drives it - NOT independently re-verified on SWITCH1 yet.
meta.mesa_modes_note: 2026-10-05: consolidated to a single bank (bank 0) - the old 3-bank layout (clean-section/dirty-section/single-amp-reference) is fully superseded, recoverable from git history if ever wanted back. Switches 1-4 are the stereo combos (both amps sounding at once - Mesa sits on the permanent left leg of the SCF Gold's stereo split, Peavey behind Switch-Track on the right leg), ordered dirty-to-clean (both dirty, mixed, mixed, both clean). Switch 5 is mute. Switches 6-9 are single-amp reference tones, also dirty-to-clean (Mesa Dirty, Peavey Dirty, Mesa Clean, Peavey Clean). Switch 10 is mute. All combos and all alone-Mesa tones here use EQ-on only - the EQ-off Mesa presets aren't used by any patch in this layout (see mesa_preset_definitions).

patches.function: Mesa Clean EQ-on + Peavey Clean (both clean)
Mesa Dirty EQ-on + Peavey Dirty (both dirty)
